prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a 2x2 transparent sprite sheet of FOUR full-body animation poses of the EXACT same paper hero in the reference, all facing RIGHT in strict SIDE PROFILE. This is a QUICK VERTICAL JUMP IN PLACE, NOT a forward leap, not running, not a flip. Preserve the oversized round warm-ivory head, one same black oval eye, SHORT compact legs, short plain shorts, soft matte painted paper grain, same wraparound long layered cloak. Both arms/hands hidden INSIDE cloak throughout. No sleeves, visible hands, new accessories, face changes, dramatic pose twist or frontal view. Head silhouette and scale identical in all cells. Feet point right; both short legs stay close under pelvis, near leg light ivory, far leg muted darker taupe.
Four equal square cells; same scale and horizontal body axis in each, all characters fully within cell with generous margins. Do NOT depict world-space jump height here; show each whole-body pose centered in its own cell so engine can move it vertically. Grounded cells have same horizontal foot baseline. Character is about TWO head diameters tall in neutral, never long-legged. Snappy compact athletic motion, not floaty, no noodle limbs. Long cape retains original broad layered shapes, motion mainly vertical and only slight horizontal cloth flutter. No floor, cast shadows, text, labels, grid, speed lines, background or colored fringe. Genuine transparent alpha.
Reading order:
TOP LEFT: ANTICIPATION. Feet both flat in the SAME small stance as reference. Knees bend compactly to load a spring, pelvis/head lowered only about 12% of head diameter, torso just a little forward. Cloak compressed gently around knees; nothing sweeps horizontally.
TOP RIGHT: TAKEOFF EXTENSION. Torso straightens vertically, both short knees extend without lengthening limbs, heels rise and toes press downward for the final push. Head above hips, no forward tilt. Cape lags downward close to legs, narrow streamlined outline.
BOTTOM LEFT: EARLY ASCENT. Both feet off ground, knees bend slightly and tuck together beneath the body, toes point slightly down/back. Both thighs stay mostly under hips, NOT a running split stride. Head/torso nearly upright. Cloak trails DOWN from upward acceleration, broad smooth tails pointed mostly down-left close to body.
BOTTOM RIGHT: APEX. Compact floating pose, knees softly folded underneath and feet close together. Torso still upright, same side-facing eye. Cape tips gently relax outward a little with residual lift, preserving the long original cloak, no big wind. Slightly less vertical tension than ascent.

processing: Crop and uniformly register complete drawings. Runtime vertical translation applies a parabola to the whole sprite; no joint rig, body rotation or generated in-between morphing.
heightRevision: User requested a slightly higher jump: +30% height and 400ms to 460ms flight; original pose artwork and grounded timings unchanged.
